svg.title: Figure 2. Specimen geometry and free-body diagram
svg.desc: Part a: side view of a round tension specimen with wider grip ends, fillets, and a reduced section 60 mm long and 10.00 mm in diameter. Two gage marks 50.0 mm apart are centered on the reduced section. Shaded zones about one diameter long next to each fillet are labeled as regions of non-uniform stress. Part b: free-body diagram of the lower piece of the gage section below a cut a–a. The grip pulls down with force P; on the cut face a uniform tensile stress sigma acts upward over the original area A0. Equilibrium of vertical forces gives sigma times A0 minus P equals zero, so sigma equals P over A0.
